messages:
Ana: Quick thread: we need a compact "SEO consolidation" plan for next week's benchmark + webinar push. Focus: redirect inventory, canonical grouping, internal-link updates, and minimal schema changes.

Maggie: Yes. Keep it bite-sized for content ops. Deliverables: CSV redirect inventory, CMS internal-link patch, schema snippets, and a short QA checklist.

Raj: Redirect rules: prefer single-hop 301s for permanent moves. For time-boxed promos use 307. Example .htaccess style: 
```
Redirect 301 /old-webinar https://redwood.ai/webinars/redwood-inference
```

Priya: Analytics: record entry source with ?src=channel (newsletter, paid, organic). For A/B paid tests use ?exp=variantA. Strip UTMs on canonical pages.

Ana: CSV template I'll share: source,old_url,new_url,redirect_type,reason,owner. Use this to drive infra PRs.

Maggie: Schema: add Event (webinar) and Article (benchmark). Include mainEntity for FAQ if we have Qs. Keep JSON-LD small and server-rendered when possible to avoid JS timing issues.

Raj: I'll open infra PR with canonical mapping and a redirect smoke test. Plan: deploy to staging 48h before launch, run an automated crawl. Example smoke curl: 
```
curl -I https://redwood.ai/old-bench
# Expect: 301 -> /blog/benchmarks
```

Priya: GA4: events to wire: webinar_view, webinar_reg, benchmark_read. Need final canonical URLs by Wed noon.

Ana: Content ops checklist: 1) update internal links in top nav/footer, 2) replace deprecated hrefs in 5 key posts, 3) add rel=canonical to migrated pages, 4) run a crawl to confirm zero chains.

AnalyticsBot: Created ticket MKT-SEO-412: "Redirect inventory + canonical mapping" assigned to Ana/Raj/Priya.

Maggie: Minor SEO note: avoid appending tracking params in server redirects; let entry pages handle tagging. Also prefer 301 for consolidations older than 30 days.

Raj: I'll include a CI test to assert no redirect chains for any URL in the CSV. Pseudocode in PR.

Ana: I'll drop the CSV in the shared drive by EOD Mon and tag owners per row.

Priya: Will prepare GA4 spec and BigQuery event schema after CSV. ETA Tue afternoon.

Maggie: After staging deploy, we'll run Lighthouse + Screaming Frog and confirm sitemap <lastmod> & priorities. Post results here.

Raj: Noted. I'll add a smoke script that checks response codes and canonical header correctness.

Ana: Thanks all. Ping this thread with PRs and the CSV link when ready.
